design_assumption: For this product-vision demo, CMMS history is intentionally assumed to be rich, clean, correctly asset-linked, and well maintained so historical evidence can become more valuable as the record grows.

boundary: This synthetic history is a deliberate product-design fixture. Historical pattern can strongly affect ranking but does not prove the current root cause, authorize an intervention, or establish current physical state.
